authorFamilyNote: authorFamilies names the company that wrote the pull request, when the GitHub login is enough to know. claude[bot] (Claude Code) is anthropic, so Grill CI excludes Anthropic. chatgpt-codex-connector[bot] (Codex) is openai, so Grill CI excludes OpenAI. An empty string means the login does not name a writing model: mtangoz, cursor[bot], cursoragent, and any other login. Those pull requests exclude nothing beyond x-ai unless the body contains a line 'Written-by-model: <vendor>/<model>', in which case that vendor is excluded too. The judge is always OpenRouter's Auto Router (openrouter/auto); Grill CI does not pin a vendor's model. alwaysExcludedVendors always includes x-ai, on every pull request. After the run, Grill CI checks the served model's vendor. If that vendor was excluded, the comment is marked NOT decorrelated, the pull request gets needs-review, and the job fails.
